title: Detailed television
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='21' y='31' width='46' height='34' rx='2' fill='#3ed8f0'/>

  <rect x='21' y='31' width='46' height='34' rx='2' fill='#1fb8d8'/>

  <circle cx='78.5' cy='35' r='1.4' fill='#d9d9e8'/>

  <circle cx='82' cy='54' r='0.9' fill='#4a4a5e'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='57' r='0.9' fill='#4a4a5e'/>

  <circle cx='82' cy='57' r='0.9' fill='#4a4a5e'/>
  <circle cx='76' cy='60' r='0.9' fill='#4a4a5e'/>

  <circle cx='82' cy='60' r='0.9' fill='#4a4a5e'/>
